why: From A to B, every line moves down one place (the bottom line goes to the top), and each end mark jumps to the other end of its line without turning. Do the same to C: the bottom fork becomes an arrow at the top, the cup moves to the left of line 2, the curve moves to the right of line 3, and the triangle moves to the left of the bottom line. Only option 5 has the curve on line 3 opening to the right, like ( . Options 1, 3 and 4 have it the wrong way, like ).
trick: Follow one mark at a time: note which line it goes to and which end, then check its direction.
note: Book scan is small and hand-drawn; options 1 and 4 look almost the same in the scan (only the cup on line 2 is drawn a little differently).
